en.summary: Database Administrator and Full Stack Developer with expertise in managing enterprise databases, system administration, and web application development. Proficient in MySQL, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, and Linux environments with strong focus on database optimization, security, and automation.

education.description: Pursuing B.Tech with focus on database systems and backend technologies.
Projects included IoT-based phishing protection system and a face-recognition attendance system.

responsibilities: Managing MySQL, PostgreSQL and enterprise databases in production environments.
High availability configuration, performance tuning and backup strategy optimization.
Database security, auditing and automation for reliability and uptime.
Linux-based database administration covering MySQL, PostgreSQL, EDB and MSSQL.
Shell scripting automation for backup, monitoring and reporting tasks.
Performance tuning, query optimization and enterprise database support.
Handled tasks similar to a combined System Administrator + DBA role.
Frontend development using HTML, CSS, JavaScript.
Backend development tasks with PHP and Laravel.
Database design and MySQL-based backend integration for web applications.
